theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors remain the dominant narrative focus (rank 1) with an intact absolute trend (eligible, hurst trend), moderate durability (0.48) and no crowding. The macro backdrop is AI/tech-heavy. Yet the trend is narrow (breadth 0.091), the recent 10-day return is negative, and the market's history of gate-whipping mean-reversion makes any trend fragile. We lean overweight conditionally, accepting low conviction.
evidence: Rotation margin 0.235: no imminent challenger overtake
theses.dissent: The absolute trend gate historically failed to reduce drawdown in this market; mean-reversion tape whipsaws trends. Narrow breadth and negative r10 imply the theme may already be stalling, risking a sharp reversal.

falsifier.text: On or before 2026-08-18 (15 trading days), the Semiconductors ETF (512760.SS) underperforms the CSI 300 by more than 2% OR its durability_bar drops below 0.35 on any subsequent detector update.
